text:
4. 3. 1

Punabbhavasuttaṃ

1705. Pañcimāni bhikkhave. Indriyāni katamāni pañca: saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ. 

Yāvakīvāhaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayañca

. 2Atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ. Yato ca kho'haṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ. Ñāṇañca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, akuppā me cetovimutti, ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
